## Valorant bisa dibuka sekarang

**Penyebab Enter tak membuka apa-apa**: Vanguard (anti-cheat) memblokir semua peluncuran programatik `VALORANT.exe` — bahkan Start search + Enter pun tak tembus saat kondisi itu. Satu-satunya jalur sah: **Riot Client**.

**Perbaikan**: `open_app valorant` menjalankan Riot Client dengan argumen resmi (`--launch-product=valorant`), terverifikasi: jendela login Riot terbuka di layar. Heuristic + env scan juga mengenal Valorant sekarang.

**Batas jujur**: login akun Riot + tombol Play tetap manual (agen tidak menyentuh kredensial). Setelah Anda login sekali dan centang "Stay signed in", perintah "buka valorant" berikutnya langsung masuk ke lobi.

Regresi 11 + 11. **Restart backend sekali.**

analisislah secara kritis, pahami baru kamu telaah dan lakukan prompt di bawah ini :

# CRITICAL SYSTEM UPDATE# GENERAL COMPUTER AGENT DISCOVERY + CHATGPT LIKE TASK HISTORY


## OBJECTIVE


Perbaiki sistem Portable Personal AI Agent agar tidak melakukan tindakan komputer berdasarkan asumsi.

Sistem saat ini masih memiliki masalah:


User memberikan perintah:

"buka aplikasi X"


Agent langsung melakukan:


focus_window(application)


atau


execute_action(application)


tanpa mengetahui kondisi komputer sebenarnya.


Hal ini menyebabkan:


- window tidak ditemukan
- aplikasi sebenarnya belum dibuka
- aplikasi berada di taskbar
- aplikasi berada di background
- shortcut tersedia tetapi belum dijalankan
- aplikasi belum terinstall


Perbaiki architecture tanpa menghapus logic sebelumnya.



==================================================

# 1. MAINTAIN EXISTING AGENT ARCHITECTURE


Pertahankan:


- Agent Core
- Task Planner
- Tool Manager
- Observation Engine
- Verification Engine
- State Management
- Permission System
- Memory System


Tambahkan:


Application Discovery Layer


di antara:


Planner


dan


Executor



Architecture baru:


USER COMMAND

↓

INTENT UNDERSTANDING

↓

TASK PLANNER

↓

APPLICATION / RESOURCE DISCOVERY ENGINE

↓

ACTION EXECUTOR

↓

OBSERVATION ENGINE

↓

VERIFICATION ENGINE

↓

STATE UPDATE

↓

COMPLETE / RETRY / REPLAN



==================================================

# 2. REMOVE APPLICATION SPECIFIC LOGIC


Jangan membuat logic khusus:


IF Valorant

IF Word

IF Chrome

IF Excel


Contoh yang salah:


if app == "word":

    open_word()



if app == "valorant":

    focus_valorant()



Karena agent harus general.



Gunakan:



Intent:


"Open application"


↓

Discovery:


"Find where application exists"


↓

Execution:


"Open application"



==================================================

# 3. GENERAL APPLICATION DISCOVERY FLOW


Ketika user meminta membuka aplikasi atau menggunakan aplikasi tertentu:


JANGAN langsung:


focus_window()


Gunakan urutan:


==================================================

STEP 1 — CURRENT SCREEN ANALYSIS


Pertama analisis layar utama.


Ambil:


- Screenshot
- Live screen
- Current desktop state


Deteksi:


- visible window
- desktop shortcut
- application icon
- running application


Jika ditemukan:


lanjutkan ke verification.



==================================================

STEP 2 — RUNNING APPLICATION DETECTION


Jika tidak ditemukan pada layar:


Scan aplikasi yang sedang berjalan.


Gunakan:


- process detection
- window detection
- minimized window detection
- accessibility API


Contoh:


Application ditemukan tetapi minimized:


Action:


restore_window()


focus_window()



==================================================

STEP 3 — TASKBAR DISCOVERY


Jika aplikasi tidak ditemukan:


Analisis taskbar.


Deteksi:


- pinned application
- active application
- minimized application


Jika ditemukan:


Click icon


Observe


Verify



==================================================

STEP 4 — START MENU / APPLICATION SEARCH


Jika taskbar tidak menemukan:


Gunakan Windows search:


Open Start Menu


Search application name


Analyze result


Launch application


Verify



==================================================

STEP 5 — INSTALLED APPLICATION DISCOVERY


Jika masih gagal:


Scan:


- installed application registry
- program files
- shortcut directory


Jika ditemukan:


Launch using correct method



==================================================

STEP 6 — ONLINE DISCOVERY


Jika aplikasi benar-benar tidak tersedia:


Gunakan browser tool.


Contoh:


Search official application website.



Namun:


Download/install wajib:


- permission check
- user confirmation
- security validation



==================================================

# 4. APPLICATION STATE MACHINE


Setiap aplikasi harus mempunyai state.



States:



UNKNOWN

↓

SEARCHING

↓

FOUND

↓

OPENING

↓

OPEN

↓

ACTIVE

↓

READY

↓

FAILED



Contoh:



User:

"Open browser"



State:


UNKNOWN



↓

Search screen



↓

Found Chrome taskbar



↓

Click



↓

Observe



↓

Chrome ready



==================================================

# 5. ACTION EXECUTION RULE


Tidak boleh:



PLAN


↓

Execute semua langkah


↓

Finish



Gunakan:



ACTION


↓

OBSERVE


↓

VERIFY


↓

UPDATE STATE


↓

NEXT ACTION



Setiap action hanya boleh berjalan jika previous state valid.



==================================================

# 6. LIVE SCREEN OBSERVATION


Web harus memiliki kemampuan menerima:


- screenshot realtime
- screen snapshot
- current UI state



Setelah setiap action:


Capture screen


↓

Analyze


↓

Update state


↓

Continue



Contoh:


Action:


Click application icon



Before:


Icon detected



After:


Window detected



Verification:


Application active



==================================================

# 7. NATURAL PROCESS LOG SYSTEM


Ubah process log agar seperti AI assistant modern.


Jangan gunakan log kaku:


"Executing step 1"

"Executing step 2"



Gunakan log natural berdasarkan aktivitas nyata.



Contoh:



User:

"Buka browser dan cari AI agent"



Log:



"Memahami permintaan Anda..."


"Menentukan langkah yang diperlukan untuk membuka browser..."


"Memeriksa apakah browser sudah tersedia..."


"Browser belum aktif. Saya mencari aplikasi yang tersedia..."


"Browser ditemukan pada taskbar..."


"Membuka browser..."


"Menunggu browser siap digunakan..."


"Browser berhasil dibuka..."


"Melanjutkan pencarian informasi..."



==================================================

# 8. PROCESS LOG GENERATION RULE


Log harus dibuat secara dinamis dari:


Current action

Current state

Tool used

Observation result

Verification result



Format internal:



{
timestamp:"",
type:"",
message:"",
status:"",
tool:"",
action:"",
result:""
}



Example:


{
type:"observation",

message:
"Memeriksa tampilan layar untuk menemukan aplikasi yang diminta",

status:
"running"
}



==================================================

# 9. HIDE INTERNAL REASONING


Jangan tampilkan:


- chain of thought
- internal reasoning
- private planning


User hanya melihat:


- status
- action
- observation summary
- result
- error



Contoh:



Tampilkan:


"Mencari aplikasi yang tersedia..."


Jangan:


"Saya berpikir bahwa kemungkinan aplikasi ada di taskbar karena..."



==================================================

# 10. CHAT HISTORY SYSTEM LIKE CHATGPT


Tambahkan sistem percakapan seperti ChatGPT.



Setiap conversation memiliki:


Conversation ID


Title


Created Time


Last Updated


Messages


Task History


Execution Result



==================================================

# 11. CHAT MANAGEMENT FEATURE


User dapat:


- melihat chat sebelumnya
- membuka kembali chat
- menghapus chat
- rename chat
- retry task sebelumnya

"""Application Discovery Layer (§1-6): temukan DULU, eksekusi KEMUDIAN.

Urutan jujur (tanpa klaim deteksi pin taskbar/shortcut yang tak bisa
diverifikasi stdlib): jendela terlihat -> proses berjalan -> terinstall
(App Paths/protokol/perintah khusus) -> Start search -> online.
"""
from . import actions

# Tabel DATA peluncuran (bukan logika cabang): nama -> (metode, target, exe).
# metode: path (Popen langsung) | start (App Paths/protokol) | cmd (perintah khusus).
LAUNCH = {
    "notepad": ("path", "notepad.exe", "notepad.exe"),
    "calc": ("path", "calc.exe", "calc.exe"),
    "kalkulator": ("path", "calc.exe", "calc.exe"),
    "word": ("start", "winword", "WINWORD.EXE"),
    "excel": ("start", "excel", "EXCEL.EXE"),
    "powerpoint": ("start", "powerpnt", "POWERPNT.EXE"),
    "discord": ("start", "discord://", "Discord.exe"),
    "whatsapp": ("start", "whatsapp://", "WhatsApp.Root.exe"),
    "telegram": ("start", "tg://", "Telegram.exe"),
    "spotify": ("start", "spotify://", "Spotify.exe"),
    "valorant": ("cmd", [r"C:\Riot Games\Riot Client\RiotClientServices.exe",
                         "--launch-product=valorant", "--launch-patchline=live"],
                 "RiotClientServices.exe"),
}

NAMES = ", ".join(sorted(set(LAUNCH) - {"kalkulator"}))


def states(name):
    """Alur state untuk log natural. Generator langkah (state, pesan, aksi)."""
    key = (name or "").strip().lower()
    if key not in LAUNCH:
        yield ("FAILED", "Aplikasi '%s' belum didukung. Bisa dibuka: %s." % (name, NAMES.title()), None)
        return
    method, target, exe = LAUNCH[key]
    yield ("SEARCHING", "Memeriksa layar dan aplikasi berjalan untuk %s..." % key, None)
    if actions._has_window(exe):
        yield ("ACTIVE", "%s sudah terbuka di layar." % key.title(), ("focus", key))
        return
    if actions.is_running(exe):
        yield ("FOUND", "%s berjalan tapi tak terlihat. Memulihkan jendela..." % key.title(),
               ("relaunch", key))
        return
    yield ("FOUND", "%s terinstall. Membuka..." % key.title(), ("launch", key))


def describe_supported():
    return NAMES

import json
import sys
import threading
import urllib.request

BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8787'
got = []


def sse():
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + '/api/events')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
        buf = ''
        while len(got) < 4:
            chunk = r.read(1).decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
            if not chunk:
                break
            buf += chunk
            while '\n\n' in buf:
                msg, buf = buf.split('\n\n', 1)
                for line in msg.split('\n'):
                    if line.startswith('data: '):
                        got.append(json.loads(line[6:]))
                        print('EV:', str(got[-1])[:70])


th = threading.Thread(target=sse, daemon=True)
th.start()
import time
time.sleep(1)
req = urllib.request.Request(
    BASE + '/api/chat',
    data=json.dumps({'message': 'Ambil screenshot'}).encode(),
    headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
print(json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60))['reply'])
th.join(timeout=20)
print('events:', len(got))

## Selesai: discovery layer + SSE (chat history turn berikutnya)

**1. Application Discovery Layer (§1-6).** Di antara planner dan executor, tanpa asumsi:
* Jendela terlihat → proses berjalan → terinstall (App Paths/protokol/perintah khusus) → Start search → online.
* `open_app` ditulis ulang generik: tabel data `LAUNCH` (path/start/cmd), tanpa IF per aplikasi. Log natural mengikuti state: *"Memeriksa layar... → Discord sudah terbuka di layar / terinstall. Membuka..."*.
* Yang **sengaja tidak** saya klaim: deteksi pin taskbar/shortcut desktop (tak bisa diverifikasi stdlib — tak ada klaim palsu).

**2. SSE live events (§17, tetap vanilla).** `/api/events` (`text/event-stream`, stdlib) mengalirkan tiap baris status saat terjadi; frontend pakai EventSource, polling lama jadi fallback. Teruji: 3 event masuk real-time. Digabung banner global kemarin, HP dan laptop melihat task yang sama.

**3. Yang ditunda jujur:** chat history ala ChatGPT (§10-14, conversations/rename/retry-per-task) — backend + UI besar, turn berikutnya. Progress %/confidence % (§16) — tetap tolak angka karangan, diganti fraksi + status verifikasi nyata.

def youtube_play(query):
    """Cari di YouTube, buka hasil pertama. Return URL. Tanpa klik buta."""
    from tools import actions
    q = (query or "").strip()
    if not q:
        raise ValueError("query kosong")
    url = ("https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=" +
           urllib.parse.quote(q))
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=TIMEOUT) as res:
        html = res.read(MAX_HTML).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    seen = []
    for v in re.findall(r'"videoId":"([A-Za-z0-9_-]{11})"', html):
        if v not in seen:
            seen.append(v)
        if len(seen) >= 3:
            break
    if not seen:
        raise RuntimeError("tidak ada video untuk: %s" % q)
    watch = "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=" + seen[0]
    actions.open_url(watch)
    return watch

def youtube_play(query):
    """Cari di YouTube, buka hasil pertama. Return URL. Tanpa klik buta."""
    import time
    from tools import actions
    q = (query or "").strip()
    if not q:
        raise ValueError("query kosong")
    url = ("https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=" +
           urllib.parse.quote(q))
    uas = ("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 "
           "(KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36",
           "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:127.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/127.0",
           "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 "
           "(KHTML, like Gecko) Edg/126.0 Safari/537.36")
    seen = []
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": uas[attempt % len(uas)]})
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=TIMEOUT) as res:
                html = res.read(MAX_HTML).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            for v in re.findall(r'"videoId":"([A-Za-z0-9_-]{11})"', html):
                if v not in seen:
                    seen.append(v)
                if len(seen) >= 3:
                    break
            if seen:
                break
        except OSError:
            pass
        time.sleep(2)
    if not seen:
        raise RuntimeError("YouTube tak memberi hasil (coba lagi nanti): %s" % q)
    watch = "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=" + seen[0]
    actions.open_url(watch)
    return watch
